name: Paving the Way

steps.t: Go to any ENELICA building
steps.go: Head to any building with ENELICA on the wall. Water Treatment Control in the middle west is the easy pick, with the Power Generation Complex in the north as an alternative.

steps.t: Search for a notice board with a note from the researcher
steps.go: Inside the ENELICA building, find the notice board and interact with it. At Water Treatment Control it sits just right of the south main entrance in the lobby.

steps.t: On Buried City, reach the top floor above the Convinio in Piazza Roma
steps.pin: Reach the top floor above the Convinio
steps.go: Buried City map. Climb the apartment block on the south side of Piazza Roma by stairs or zipline, watching for a Rocketeer on the roof.
steps.show: Buried City: top floor, Piazza Roma.

steps.t: Find the researcher's flat and search for any research data
steps.go: Buried City map. Drop to the lower roof, cross the scrap bridge, go through the next room and use the marked computer console.

notes: which notice board is which building is unconfirmed, so step 2 has no pin

name: A Bad Feeling

steps.t: Find and search any ARC Probe or ARC Courier
steps.go: On any map, follow a column of black smoke to a downed Probe or Courier and search it. Dam Battlegrounds spawns them most reliably.

notes: MetaForge's light bulb pin matches no step, so it isn't used

name: A Rising Tide

steps.t: On Buried City, find the foreman's barricaded apartment south of Piazza Roma
steps.go: Buried City map. Ride the zipline between the two Piazza Roma towers and drop onto the platform on your right, or take the stairs in the A2 block.

steps.t: Access the foreman's digital logbook
steps.go: Buried City map. Inside the apartment, use the terminal with the logbook on it, then extract.

steps.t: Reach the Power Generation Complex and find a way into the Controlled Access Zone
steps.go: Go to the Power Generation Complex in the north, then head south-west to the marked ladder and climb down into the Controlled Access Zone.
steps.show: Down the ladder into the zone.

steps.t: Search the Controlled Access Zone for any clues about the foreman's reconstruction project
steps.pin: Step 3: Clues about the Reconstruction Project
steps.go: Follow the walkway round the hanging ARC into the room with windows over it and interact with the whiteboard. If the door has no power, slot a battery into the walkway socket.

notes: the logbook step's wording isn't confirmed

name: Taking Stock

steps.t: Photograph the sculpture in the Atrium
steps.pin: Take a photo of the sculpture in the Atrium
steps.go: Stella Montis map. Take a Basic Camera to the upper-level Atrium between the Loading Bay and Cultural Archives and photograph the star-shaped sculpture.

steps.t: Photograph a Baron Husk
steps.pin: Take a photo of a Baron Husk
steps.go: Spaceport map. Find a dormant Baron Husk, often along the wall between the outer and inner areas, and photograph it.

steps.t: Ping a Bombardier (Dam Battlegrounds) or a Bastion (Buried City)
steps.go: Spot a Bombardier and ping it. No damage needed. A Bastion on Buried City also counts.

steps.t: Collect and deliver 3 Industrial Batteries
steps.go: Loot three Industrial Batteries from Industrial areas, for example the Hydroponic Dome Complex on Dam, then hand them to the Nomadic Envoy in Speranza.

notes: step wording paraphrased; no guide quotes it exactly

steps.t: Scan a crashed ARC Probe
steps.go: On any map except Stella Montis, follow black smoke to a downed Probe and hold the prompt to scan it.

steps.t: Scan an ARC Courier
steps.go: Find a Courier the same way, by its smoke and map icon, and scan it.

steps.t: Find the Gondola Prototype
steps.go: On Dam, head to Red Lakes and look for the prototype on a flatbed trailer. Farmlands on Blue Gate, East Plains on Spaceport and Dried Riverbed on Riven Tides also have one.

steps.t: Install ARC Pop Trigger, ARC Synthetic Resin, ARC Thermo Lining and ARC Performance Steel
steps.go: Use the points round the prototype to fit all four rare ARC parts. Any order, so bring them with you.

steps.t: Activate the Gondola Prototype
steps.go: Hold the activate prompt, then step back: it blows up and completes the quest.

steps.t: Reach the Water Treatment Building in The Dam
steps.pin: Reach the Water Treatment Building in The Dam
steps.go: Head to Water Treatment Control in the middle west of the map.

steps.t: Search for the Flood Spill Intake near the Swamp
steps.go: Go round to the north side of the building, by the swamp, to find the intake.

steps.t: Investigate any suspicious objects
steps.go: Interact with the waste barrel at the intake to finish the quest.

steps.t: Go to the Research & Administration building in Dam Battlegrounds
steps.pin: Go to the Research & Administration building
steps.go: Head to the Research & Administration building and enter by the reception.

steps.t: Locate Lab 1 on the upper floor, above reception
steps.go: Take the zip lines up from reception, follow the balcony right to the end, turn left and Lab 1 is the first door on the left.

steps.t: Search for any traces of the agricultural research project
steps.go: Interact with the documents on the Lab 1 table, then extract.
